verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਬੇ ਕੋ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਦੇਖ ਚੋਰ ਨ ਤਜਤ ਚੋਰੀ ਬਟਵਾਰਾ ਬਟਵਾਰੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੈ੍ਵ ਤਕਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: maarabe ko traas dhekh chor na tajat choree baTavaaraa baTavaaree sa(n)g haivai takat hai ||

en.bdb: Despite fear of death lurking around, a thief doesn't give up Stealing. A dacoit keeps targeting other wayfarers along with other members of his gang.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੇਸ੍ਵਾ ਰਤੁ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਨਾ ਸੰਕਾ ਮਾਨੈ ਜੂਆਰੀ ਨ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਹਾਰੈ ਸੈ ਥਕਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: besavaiaa rat birathaa bhe man mai naa sa(n)kaa maanai jooaaree na sarabas haarai sai thakat hai ||

en.bdb: Knowing that his visit to the house of a whore can cause him serious disease, a licentious person still doesn't feel hesitant to go there. A gambler never feels tired of gambling even after losing all his assets and the family.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਮਲੀ ਨ ਅਮਲ ਤਜਤ ਜਿਯੋਂ ਧਿਕਾਰ ਕੀਏ ਦੋਖ ਦੁਖ ਲੋਗ ਬੇਦ ਸੁਨਤ ਛਕਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: amalee na amal tajat jiyo(n) dhikaar ke'ee dhokh dhukh log bedh sunat chhakat hai ||

en.bdb: An addict keeps consuming drugs and intoxicants despite monitions, learning the effects of drug abuse from religious scriptures and people who have societal interests at heart, just can't give up his addiction.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਧਮ ਅਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਛਾਡਤ ਨ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਛਾਡ ਕਯੋਂ ਸਕਤ ਹੈ ॥੩੨੩॥
verses.translit_en: adham asaadh sa(n)g chhaaddat na a(n)geekaar gursikh saadh sa(n)g chhaadd kayo(n) sakat hai ||323||

en.bdb: Even all these low and base people cannot give up their deeds, then how can an obedient devotee of Guru leave company of true and noble people? (323)
